name: Pixellize URL & Metadata Exporter
author: Pixellize

sections.description:
Pixellize URL & Metadata Exporter is a fast, focused tool for pulling a clean, well-structured CSV out of any WordPress site.

Pick a post type, choose the fields you want, narrow the result with rich filters, and download a CSV that is ready for Excel, Google Sheets, SEO tools, content audits, redirect maps, or full-site migrations. The plugin shows you the row count before you export, remembers what you exported last time, and streams large jobs in batches so it stays stable on sites with tens of thousands of posts.

Core features

  • Single-select post type with an All Types option that covers pages, posts, and every public custom post type.
  • Pick the Export Fields you want as columns:
    • Post ID, Title, URL.
    • Categories, Category URLs, Tags, Tag URLs.
    • Author, Published Date, Modified Date, Status.
  • Choose Post Statuses to include: Published, Pending, Draft & Auto Draft, Future Scheduled, Private, Trashed, or an All master option.
  • Clean CSV output with a UTF-8 BOM so accented characters render correctly in Excel.

Filter Options panel (click “Show Filter Options” to reveal)

  • Title Contains text search (title-only, not body).
  • Featured Image: Any, Has featured image, or No featured image.
  • Published Date Range (From / To).
  • Modified Date Range (From / To), independent from the publish range.
  • Filter by Term: pick any public taxonomy from a dropdown, then choose one or more terms from a scrollable, searchable list. Terms are loaded on demand via a REST endpoint, so the form stays fast even on big sites.
  • By Author: scrollable, searchable list of all users who have published posts. Multi-select supported.

Advanced Options panel (click “Show Advanced Options”)

  • Row Limit: cap the number of rows, or set to -1 for no limit.

UX touches

  • Live row count in the sticky action bar at the bottom of the page. Updates as you change filters: “Will export 3,245 rows” or “Will export 500 of 3,245 matching rows” when a limit is set.
  • Export Now button disables automatically when no rows match.
  • Sticky Export bar stays visible while you scroll through long lists.
  • Remembers your last settings per user. Filter and Advanced panels auto-open if you had filters or a row limit saved.

Performance on big sites

  • Batched streaming export: posts are fetched 500 at a time and flushed to the browser per batch, so memory stays flat regardless of how many rows you export.
  • Term cache warming: categories and tags are primed for the whole batch in a single query, killing per-post lookups (N+1).
  • PHP time limit is lifted during export so very large jobs do not get cut off.
  • Export stops cleanly if you close the browser tab.
  • Tune the chunk size with the pixellize_url_exporter_batch_size filter.

WP-CLI

  • wp pixellize-url-exporter export --fields=title,url --out=posts.csv
  • wp pixellize-url-exporter export --post-type=page --statuses=publish,draft
  • wp pixellize-url-exporter export --tax=category --terms=1,2 --modified-from=2025-01-01
  • wp pixellize-url-exporter fields lists every available field key.
  • Full flag set: --post-type, --statuses, --fields, --authors, --date-from, --date-to, --modified-from, --modified-to, --title-contains, --featured-image=yes|no, --tax, --terms, --limit, --out.

Developer hooks

  • pixellize_url_exporter_fields filter to add, remove, or relabel export field columns.
  • pixellize_url_exporter_query_args filter to modify the underlying WP_Query arguments before posts are fetched.
  • pixellize_url_exporter_field_value filter to supply or override the value for any cell (including custom field keys added via pixellize_url_exporter_fields).
  • pixellize_url_exporter_batch_size filter to tune the streaming chunk size.
  • pixellize_url_exporter_terms_limit filter to raise the term list cap (default 500).

Security

  • Capability-gated: only users with the export capability (Administrators by default) can run an export.
  • Nonce-verified form submissions and REST requests.
  • All inputs sanitized at the boundary.

Use cases

  • SEO audits and sitemap reviews.
  • Redirect map planning before a migration.
  • Content inventories, freshness audits, and link checks.
  • Pulling lists of posts per author, per term, or within a publish / modified window.
  • Building reports for clients without granting them dashboard access.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder pixellize-url-metadata-exporter to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools > Export URLs & Metadata to start exporting.
sections.faq:
Where do I find the export tool?

After activation, go to Tools > Export URLs & Metadata in the WordPress admin sidebar.

Which user roles can export?

Any user with the export capability. By default this is Administrators only.

Can I export custom post types?

Yes. Every public post type, including custom ones registered by your theme or other plugins, is listed in the “Select a Post Type to Extract Data” section. Choose All Types to combine everything in one CSV.

How do I filter by a specific category, tag, or custom taxonomy term?

Click Show Filter Options, then use Filter by Term. Pick the taxonomy from the dropdown, then tick one or more terms from the searchable list. Leave all terms unchecked to include the entire taxonomy.

Can I filter by date range?

Yes, two ranges are available. Published Date Range filters by post_date and Modified Date Range filters by post_modified. They can be used together.

Can I export only posts with (or without) a featured image?

Yes. The Featured Image filter has three options: Any, Has featured image, No featured image.

How do I export posts from a specific author only?

Click Show Filter Options, search for the author by name in the By Author list, and tick the box. You can pick multiple authors.

How can I tell how many rows I will get before clicking Export?

The sticky bar at the bottom of the page shows a live row count that updates as you change filters. It also shows the cap when you set a Row Limit: “Will export 500 of 3,245 matching rows”.

Will the plugin remember my last settings?

Yes. Your last export configuration is saved per user and prefills the form when you come back.

Does the exported CSV open correctly in Excel?

Yes. The file is written with a UTF-8 BOM so accented characters and non-Latin text render correctly in Excel and Google Sheets.

Can it handle very large sites?

Yes. The plugin streams the CSV in batches of 500 posts at a time, with term cache warmed per batch, so memory stays flat even on sites with tens of thousands of posts. Use the pixellize_url_exporter_batch_size filter to tune the chunk size.

Is there a WP-CLI command?

Yes. Run wp pixellize-url-exporter export --fields=title,url --out=posts.csv. See wp help pixellize-url-exporter export for the full flag reference, or wp pixellize-url-exporter fields for the list of available column keys.

Can developers add custom export fields?

Yes. Use the pixellize_url_exporter_fields filter to register new field keys and labels, and pixellize_url_exporter_field_value to return the value for each post. You can also modify the underlying query via pixellize_url_exporter_query_args.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. A base pixellize-url-metadata-exporter.pot file is shipped in /languages for translators to start from.
sections.changelog:
0.1

  • Initial release.
  • Export URLs, titles, and metadata of posts, pages, and custom post types to CSV.
  • Export Fields: Post ID, Title, URL, Categories, Category URLs, Tags, Tag URLs, Author, Published Date, Modified Date, Status.
  • Post Status options: Published, Pending, Draft & Auto Draft, Future Scheduled, Private, Trashed, All.
  • Filter Options panel: Title Contains, Featured Image (Any / Has / No), Published Date Range, Modified Date Range, Filter by Term (any public taxonomy + searchable term list), By Author with name search.
  • Advanced Options: row limit.
  • Live row count preview in a sticky action bar. Export Now button disables when no rows match.
  • Remembers last settings per user. Filter and Advanced panels auto-open when prior filters or a row limit were saved.
  • Batched streaming export (500 posts at a time) with warm term cache, safe on sites with tens of thousands of posts.
  • PHP time limit lifted during export. Stops cleanly if the user closes the tab.
  • WP-CLI: wp pixellize-url-exporter export with flags for every form option, plus wp pixellize-url-exporter fields.
  • REST endpoints: POST /pixellize-url-exporter/v1/count for live row counts and GET /pixellize-url-exporter/v1/terms for the taxonomy term picker.
  • Developer hooks: pixellize_url_exporter_fields, pixellize_url_exporter_query_args, pixellize_url_exporter_field_value, pixellize_url_exporter_batch_size, pixellize_url_exporter_terms_limit.
  • Translation-ready with pixellize-url-metadata-exporter.pot.
